Content that makes a viewer hungry is content showing appetizing food being prepared or served. Items 81001 (tomato-and-pasta dinner with finished plate), 81003 (bread baked and sliced for eating) and 81006 (salad intended to be eaten) each show edible food in their own caption, so they are selected.
